DIVIDER_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Carcass / divider board thickness (CPT) when the params give none.

FEATURE_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Extra width added to CPT for grooves and notches a board slides into (slot = CPT + this).

DEFAULT_ROUTER_DIAMETER_MM.doc: Router bit diameter assumed for grooves.

BOTTOM_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Bottom panel thickness for the legacy XD-based entry points.

T1_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Top clearance height (TCH) when the params give none: height of the hidden top rails T1/T2.

T3_DEPTH_MM.doc: Top rear panel T3: depth from the carcass front, mm. Sits in the divider front step.

T3_NOTCH_DEPTH_MM.doc: Depth of the T3 notch that clears each divider.

T4_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Height of the vertical top plate T4 on the divider rear notches.

T4_NOTCH_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Height of the T4 notch that clears each divider.

T4_SCREW_HOLE_NOTCH_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: T4 screw hole: clearance above the notch.

T4_SCREW_HOLE_UP_SHIFT_MM.doc: T4 screw hole: additional upward shift.

FRONT_TOP_NOTCH_Y_OFFSET_MM.doc: Divider front top notch: start Y from the carcass front (style 1).

FRONT_TOP_STEP_Y_MM.doc: Divider front step: run in Y past the notch offset.

DEFAULT_FRONT_PANEL_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Door / front panel thickness (FPT) when the params give none.

DEFAULT_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Gap between neighbouring fronts and at the cabinet edges when the params give none.

DEFAULT_HINGE_HOLE_FROM_TOP_MM.doc: Hinge cup centre from the top edge of an up flap.

DEFAULT_HINGE_HOLE_FROM_SIDE_MM.doc: Hinge cup centre from each side edge of an up flap.

LED_GROOVE_WIDTH_MM.doc: LED insert groove width (shared with General Tall / Kitchen / Fridge).

LED_GROOVE_FRONT_LAND_MM.doc: Clear strip from the T3 front edge to the near wall of the main LED channel.

LED_GROOVE_BRANCH_END_INSET_MM.doc: LED T-branch centres inset from each X end of T3.

RANGEHOOD_MIN_EDGE_MM.doc: NCE rangehood: minimum material left around the cutout.

RANGEHOOD_DEFAULT_CLEAR_HEIGHT_MM.doc: NCE rangehood: clear height from BP top to the insert top when the params give none.
